entities.name: CoaBC bifunctional enzyme
observations: Sequence is strongly homologous to reviewed Vibrio CoaBC proteins: 50.9–52.0% identity over 96–98% coverage; enzyme identification for the query is homology-supported, not direct experimental evidence.
Reference annotation: catalyzes phosphopantothenate-cysteine ligation and subsequent 4-phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation in CoA biosynthesis; associated with FMN and Mg2+.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenate ligation
observations: (R)-4'-phosphopantothenate + L-cysteine + CTP → N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + CMP + diphosphate + H+; EC 6.3.2.5; Rhea RHEA:19397.

entities.name: Phosphopantothenoylcysteine decarboxylation
observations: N-[(R)-4-phosphopantothenoyl]-L-cysteine + H+ → (R)-4'-phosphopantetheine + CO2; EC 4.1.1.36; Rhea RHEA:16793.
